assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: The branch of xy = c^2 in the first quadrant with a point P; the blue tangent at P meets the axes at a1 and b1, and the red normal at P meets them at a2 and b2 (b2 below the origin).

difficulty_rationale: Requires finding the tangent and normal to a rectangular hyperbola at a general point and computing the four intercepts; the relation then follows by direct algebra.
